data.name: Mueezah
data.gender_notes: Mueezah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Mueezah is an Islamic name of Arabic origin that means 'praiser of the Lord'. It is unisex and used in various Islamic cultures including Urdu, Hindi, Arabic, and Pashto. The name Mueezah carries the meaning “Praiser of the Lord” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in English, Urdu, Hindi. Parents who choose Mueezah usually hope their child will grow to embody praiser of the lord and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: To carry the quality of praising the Lord, recognizing His glory and blessings, and expressing gratitude.
data.etymology: Mueezah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Praiser of the Lord.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Mueezah total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.
